headline: Who Is Cortis? Members, Debut and Fandom Name
description: Cortis, explained: the five members, the August 2025 debut under BigHit Music, what the name means, and the Coer fandom, plus where to take a Cortis quiz.

itemListElement.name: Who Is Cortis? Members, Debut and Fandom Name

acceptedAnswer.text: Cortis is a five-member boy group under BigHit Music, HYBE's label. They debuted on August 18, 2025 with the digital single 'What You Want'. The members are Martin, James, Juhoon, Seonghyeon and Keonho.

mainEntity.name: How many members does Cortis have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cortis has five members: Martin, James, Juhoon, Seonghyeon and Keonho. They debuted as a group with no prior lineup changes.
Cortis debuted on August 18, 2025 under BigHit Music, HYBE's label, with the digital single 'What You Want'.

mainEntity.name: What is the Cortis fandom name?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cortis's official fandom name is Coer. It combines 'Cor' from Cortis with '-er' for those who stand with the group, and echoes the word 'core'.
